description: Turns raw notes into tiered coaching-review content, as the review editor's draft does, and saves NOTHING: mode notes (default) formats notes into wentWell, tier1 (priority feedback) and tier2 (with optional photos), with optional staffName and visit details; mode sections lightly polishes manager-filled sections passed as content. It never loses the manager's text (a model failure comes back as the notes themselves). Save the result with save_coaching_review. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same draft without asking the model again.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: format_coaching_review
title: Draft a coaching review from notes
